exposure: second or higher order of the birth
average or large size of the child at birth
non-agricultural work of the woman's husband
cohort: 6,616 Indonesian women who gave birth in the two years preceding the 2017 Indonesia Demographic and Health Survey
finding: Caesarean deliveries, not having early skin-to-skin contact with the newborn, and not having a skilled birth attendant were statistically significant predictors of not having early initiation of breastfeeding.
mod_finding: Caesarean deliveries reduce the likelihood of early initiation of breastfeeding by half compared to vaginal deliveries.
